effects.description: (4 items) Reduces your damage taken from environmental traps by 40%.

(5 items) When you deal damage, you have a |cffffff25|r% chance to create desecrated ground for |cffffff5|r seconds, which reduces the Movement Speed of enemies within |cffffff3.5|r meters by 60%, damages them for 349 Magic damage every |cffffff1|r second, and heals you for |cffffff100|r% of the damage done. This effect can occur once every |cffffff5|r seconds and the damage scales off your Max Health.
